summary: Our team successfully developed a comprehensive strategy and survival simulation game centered around managing a Martian outpost, built completely from scratch with custom game mechanics and a sleek, 2D sci-fi user interface. The core gameplay revolves around critical resource management—such as balancing power, water supplies, and cultivating vital crops like potatoes, soy, quinoa, and cabbage—mirroring the exact operational priorities of a real planetary colony. To bring this vision to life, we organized ourselves like a professional space mission crew, splitting our workload into technical development and creative communication. We also utilized artificial intelligence to brainstorm visual concepts and gather scientific data regarding real astronaut challenges.   Crucially, our project connects directly to the NASA Space Apps Challenge "Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer". By designing an interactive training simulator focused on life-support systems, resource management, and survival decision-making on Mars, our game prepares young learners to think like real astronauts. It translates complex aerospace concepts into an engaging educational tool, empowering the next generation of space explorers to master the essential skills needed for deep space missions.
details: Our project involves the development of a video game with two main objectives: the first is to help young astronauts develop problem-solving skills as well as equipment and resource management abilities in a potential outpost on Mars, training them for the future; the second is to scout new minds among the highest-performing players to bring them into contact with the frontier of space exploration. The game is programmed using the Unity engine, which utilizes the C# programming language, and it is a survival management game where the player takes command of a Martian outpost and must manage its resources and deal with emergencies. All mechanics are based on real planetary data—atmospheric conditions, climate, and temperature—and the player will learn to make the best use of the materials at their disposal while developing adaptability to every event
